title: Conditional coupled propagation estimate for the first charge lift

coupled_identity.commutation: Q commutes with D_mu and with the real radial multiplier f(||phi||^2)
coupled_identity.energy_exchange: dE_Q,f/dt=integral E dot j_Q+(1/2)integral partial_t f ||psi||^2
coupled_identity.assumptions: smooth common-core solution; mu>0, m>0, f>=0; E and partial_t f integrable in time with values in L-infinity
coupled_identity.uncancelled_exchange: the original Maxwell energy cancels the matter current j_phi, not the lifted current j_Q
